2026-09-02 (cleanup): the July curated-archive work is committed and the repo is cleaned.
Every route is now static (theme moved from a cookie to localStorage). The
pre-July site (Hero, About, Skills, Experience, Contact form, voice demo, GitHub
widget, theme toggle) and the public `/api/realtime/session` token-minting route
are deleted; nothing rendered them. Reachspan is hidden from the roster and
`/projects/reachspan` redirects to `/projects`. Upstash, clsx and tailwind-merge
are removed. README.md and docs/STACK.md describe the current site.

`src/lib/projects.data.json` is the single source of truth for the project
roster. The site and the résumé PDF are derived from it (`make resume`). There
is no `PROJECTS_OVERVIEW.md` in this repo.

## Gotchas

The homepage hero cards are hand-picked in `PortfolioHome.tsx`, not generated
from the roster. Adding a project to the JSON does not put it on the homepage.

`ProjectsAll.tsx` orders the four selected projects by a hard-coded title list.
A featured project whose title is not in that list sorts first.

Do not run `vercel --prod`. It does not move the production alias.

Vercel Web Analytics is installed in the layout but the Analytics API reports it
as not enabled for the project; enable it in the Vercel dashboard.
